page.content:
Last great Imperial general who fights the Foundation.

How Bel Riose connects

  • Faction: Galactic Empire — Riose is a general of the Galactic Empire.
  • Work: Foundation and Empire — Bel Riose is the Imperial general of the first half of that book.

What is Bel Riose?

Bel Riose is the Empire's capable general in Foundation and Empire, too successful for a dying court, sent against the Foundation on the rim.

Key threads lead to Galactic Empire and Foundation and Empire.
